description: Preprint paper search across CS, physics, math, biology, economics for cutting-edge research

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Values: `relevance` (relevance, default), `date_submitted` (submission date), `date_updated` (update date).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction. Values: `asc` (ascending), `desc` (descending, default). Only effective when `sort` is non-empty.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Query field restriction. Values: `ti` (title), `au` (author), `abs` (abstract), `co` (comments), `jr` (journal reference), `cat`/`category` (category), `all` (all fields, default).

parameters.name: year_from
parameters.description: Publication year lower bound (inclusive), e.g., `2020`.

parameters.name: year_to
parameters.description: Publication year upper bound (inclusive), e.g., `2024`.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Document language ISO code, e.g., `en` (English), `zh` (Chinese), `de` (German).

parameters.name: doi
parameters.description:
DOI direct lookup. Skips keyword search and returns the single publication matching the DOI.
Format: standard DOI, e.g., 10.1145/3292500.3330701
When doi is provided, query may be empty and other filter parameters are ignored.

parameters.name: open_access
parameters.description:
Whether to return only open access publications.
Valid values: true / false

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: 1. Document type filter. Valid values: `article`, `book`, `book-chapter`, `dataset`, `dissertation`, `preprint`, `report`, `review`, `other`. 2. Publication type, comma-separated multi-value (no spaces). Valid values (13): `JournalArticle`, `Conference`, `Review`, `CaseReport`, `ClinicalTrial`, `Dataset`, `Editorial`, `LettersAndComments`, `MetaAnalysis`, `News`, `Study`, `Book`, `BookSection`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Valid values: `cited_by_count`, `publication_date`, `publication_year`, `relevance_score`, `display_name`. Append `:asc` or `:desc` to specify direction, e.g., `cited_by_count:desc`. Default: sort by relevance.

parameters.name: venue
parameters.description: Journal/conference name, comma-separated multi-value. Must match S2 database exactly. Common values: `NeurIPS`, `ICML`, `ICLR`, `CVPR`, `Nature`, `Science`, `Cell`, `Lancet`. Maps to `venue` parameter.

parameters.name: year_from
parameters.description:
Publication year start (inclusive), four digits.
Example: 2020

parameters.name: year_to
parameters.description:
Publication year end (inclusive), four digits.
Example: 2024
For single-year queries, set year_from and year_to to the same value.
